spec_match.rationale: Eight checks each mirror a normative RTCDTMFSender rule (canInsertDTMF, InvalidStateError, InvalidCharacterError, uppercase normalisation, clamping, comma pause, buffer replacement, recvonly, video dtmf null).

interactive.rationale: Run-all plus a per-check button; each check runs on a fresh loopback and shows raw observations and a verdict badge.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The feature-index card for this concept describes exactly the controls and observations on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: This page is the edge-case portfolio: recvonly transceivers, video senders, timing clamps and replacement mid-play.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5160724576993280, the WebRTC 1.0 DTMF sections and sibling concepts; the feature index adds the blink-dev intent, WPT, crbug and use counter.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite has 9 assertions: three removal checks that fail on Chrome 153 (prototype, typeof, throwing call on an added audio track) and six replacement-contract checks that pass.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chrome for Testing 153 headless via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment), desktop 1280x800 and mobile 360x740 DPR3 touch, every control clicked, two runs per viewport: zero console errors, zero failed requests, zero horizontal overflow. Observed: 8/8 match on Chrome 153; clamp interval measured ~103 ms for requested 10/5 ms, comma pause ~2030 ms, replacement sequence 1|9|''. Partial because the post-removal (Chrome 160) side could not be executed and chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable.

telemetry_health.rationale: One assertion per check with the observed text.

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables for colour; verdict text uses --accent-emerald-dark / --accent-rose on --bg-ivory (AA); the IVR screen uses --bg-ivory on --text-black.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons/inputs with labels or aria-labels, keyboard-operable, polite live regions for asynchronous results, aria-busy during work, focus returned to Start after hang-up where relevant.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Usable at 360x740 DPR3 touch and 1280x800: no page overflow, 44px+ targets, tables/code scroll inside their own regions.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a real Chrome 160 build
openQuestions.detail: Only the pre-removal side executed here (Chrome 153). On 160 the probes should flip to REMOVED / TypeError; confirm on Canary once the removal CL and its runtime flag land.

openQuestions.title: Clamp check tolerance vs observed Chromium timing
openQuestions.detail: Chromium spaces tones at about duration + 2 x gap (103 ms for a clamped 40/30). The check passes on any clearly clamped interval >= 60 ms; decide whether to file a Chromium bug or tighten the check.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Verification used headless Chrome via Playwright; chrome-devtools-mcp was unavailable (project rule 7b), so the accessibility tree was not inspected.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible keypad buttons grid touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Controls at least 44x44 CSS px on touch; let rows wrap; keep content inside its box down to 320px; wide 2D content scrolls in its own keyboard-focusable named region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons min-height 44px (keypad keys 48-52px), control rows flex-wrap, tables in tabindex=0 role=region wrappers with aria-label, pre blocks overflow-x auto.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright 360x740 DPR3: documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth === 0 on every page.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status updates for asynchronous results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native buttons/labels and announce asynchronous state changes through a polite status/live region.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Async results (negotiation, verdicts, decoder output) are written to role=status / aria-live=polite / output elements; busy buttons get aria-busy and are disabled during async work.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive layout no horizontal overflow mobile code blocks
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Adapt layout with intrinsic sizing; avoid fixed widths that overflow narrow viewports.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Two-column panels collapse to one column below 760px using minmax(0,1fr); code blocks scroll internally.

summary: 8/8 match on Chrome 153; clamp interval measured ~103 ms for requested 10/5 ms, comma pause ~2030 ms, replacement sequence 1|9|''. Verified with headless Chrome 153 on desktop and mobile; the Chrome 160 removed-state branch is implemented but could not run here.
